title: Fix Dirty Dependency Propagation on Delete
description: Clicking flow canvas background triggers computing animation on all nodes. Gate evaluate/persist on pointer up to tree changes only; fix fixtureJson prop effect resetting lastEvalFixtureRef on presentational-only updates.
summary: Deleting a downstream node no longer flashes computing chrome on upstream parents. The fixtureJson prop effect stopped nulling lastEvalFixtureRef on tree changes (which forced structural full-graph animation). flowTreeDirtyNeuronIds now also marks surviving downstream targets when a widget is removed.
